item.tib: rgyan 'god dang tshogs skong shog chung
item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yi/ sgab mchog yid bzhin nor bu las/ shog chung gud du bkod pa 'di/ phyi rabs gshen po'i don ched du/ stong (stang) tshon bdag gis yi ger bkod/ skal ldan khyed la snyan du brgyud/ gsang sbas thabs la mkhas par gyis/ skal ldan gcig brgyud ma gtogs pa'i/ dam nyams ru tra'i rigs la ma ston cig/
